newsitem.title: SPAIN: Designer Adolfo Dominguez studies Madrid flotation.
newsitem.headline: Designer Adolfo Dominguez studies Madrid flotation.

text.p: Spanish fashion house Adolfo Dominguez is considering a public flotation on the Madrid bourse, a source at the company told Reuters.
Spanish press reports on Wednesday said an initial public offering of at least 25 percent of the firm's capital is being considered, possibly to take place before the end of the year.
However the source said this is "one of a number of possibilities" to strengthen the finances of the prestigious Galician firm. A decision will be taken before the end of the month, he added.
The firm has annual turnover of more than five billion pesetas and employs around 500 people.
No one at Banco Central Hispano, reported to be managing the possible flotation, was available for comment.
